title: First run: a finish at launch while a connected cloud has not opened yet counts the phone copy's erase count under the cloud's name
evidence: From the owner's review after PR 1608. ios/HealthRoadmap/App/RootView.swift:216-222 decideFirstRun can finish at launch (S42: deciding x launched with a full record, never finished), and finished() at RootView.swift:235-236 calls takeCount() (RootView.swift:211-214), which writes onboardedEpoch from store.myData (the phone's copy while a connected cloud has not opened) and onboardedSource = source (the cloud's name). The rule above it, recordChanged at RootView.swift:202-209 (comment 202-204, the guard at 208), says the phone's copy of a connected cloud never sets the count: only the opened cloud record does. Once the cloud opens, source equals onboardedSource, so the count is compared, not taken. A lower count than the cloud's could later bring back the after-erase questions (erasedElsewhere, RootView.swift:196-200) if the cloud profile lacks an answer, so it errs toward asking again. The questions' own finish (questions x finished, the same finished() path) already has the same pattern. US-54 AC7, US-57 AC9 Done: the pure Cover.countable(source:open:) in ios/HealthRoadmap/App/FirstRun.swift (the phone's record when local-only, the opened cloud record when connected) gates RootView.takeCount, so finished() takes nothing before a connected cloud opens, and recordChanged's uncounted reuses it; the opening then finds source != onboardedSource and takes the cloud's count. FirstRunTests: the helper's table, a launch finish before the cloud opens then the opening (the cloud's count; no false erase at that count), a local launch finish, the questions' own finish. Left open: if onboardedSource already names that cloud (a count taken earlier from it, or by this bug before the fix), an unopened finish keeps that older count and the opening compares rather than takes.
